setup_steps: Checked the workspace: Java 21 and Docker 29.9.2 were present, Nextflow was not.
Downloaded Nextflow 25.10.4 into the workspace as ./nextflow. It reports version 25.10.4 build 11173.
Downloaded the test profile's samplesheet to inputs/test_samplesheet.csv. It has 5 samples: WT_REP1 (2 rows), WT_REP2, RAP1_UNINDUCED_REP1, RAP1_UNINDUCED_REP2 (2 rows) and RAP1_IAA_30M_REP1.
Started creating per-sample samplesheets in inputs/. Only inputs/WT_REP1.csv was started, and it holds just the header line. The shell refused loops, so the other four were not made.
Launched the validation run with -profile test,docker.

runs.failure_cause: Nextflow could not pull nf-core/rnaseq from GitHub. It got HTTP 403 with the message 'GitHub access to this repository is not enabled for this session. Use add_repo to request access...'. The pipeline code was never fetched, so no process ran.

failures_caught: validation: pulling nf-core/rnaseq 3.27.0 failed with a 403 from GitHub ('Forbidden -- Provide your GitHub user name and password'). The nextflow log has the real message, as byte codes: this session has no GitHub access to the repo. curl to github.com and api.github.com also returned 403. This is an access restriction, not a transient fault, so I did not use a -resume retry. I also did not try to get around it, for example by fetching the pipeline from a mirror or a different host. The test-data URLs on raw.githubusercontent.com were reachable. Docker and Java are fine.
needs_a_person: Grant this session GitHub access to nf-core/rnaseq. The message points to an 'add_repo' step, which I have no tool for. Alternatively, provide a local copy of the pipeline or a credential. Then the validation run needs to be re-launched.

The six sample runs (sample_WT_REP1, sample_WT_REP2, sample_RAP1_UNINDUCED_REP1, sample_RAP1_UNINDUCED_REP2, sample_RAP1_IAA_30M_REP1, sample_COLLAB_REP1) have not been started. They depend on the pipeline being reachable.

Four of the five per-sample samplesheets still need to be written. inputs/WT_REP1.csv is header-only and needs its two WT_REP1 rows added. The collaborator's samplesheet (inputs/collab_samplesheet.csv) points to a single-end COLLAB_REP1_R1.fastq.gz with strandedness 'reverse'. I did not inspect that FASTQ, so its validity is unchecked.

what: Cloned nf-core/rnaseq at tag 3.27.0 with git into Nextflow's asset cache (~/.nextflow/assets/nf-core/rnaseq)
why: The sandbox's GitHub proxy serves git clones of public repos but refuses GitHub API calls for repos not attached to the session, so 'Pulling nf-core/rnaseq' got HTTP 403. The agent diagnosed this correctly and stopped without working around it.

what: Harness fix: the agent's shell now also allows cd, tee and for-loops, and 'docker --version'
why: The first allowlist was stricter than intended and blocked the agent from writing the per-sample samplesheets with a loop; it wrote one by hand and stopped. Not a pipeline or parameter change.
